verdict.rationale: Omnara is explicitly open-source (Apache 2.0) and marketed as 'free to self-host and build on,' and GitHub docs confirm self-hosted deployments can run their own Postgres for agent history, implying a full self-hosted stack is possible. However, there is no detailed documentation or independent evidence of container/Docker or VM deployment instructions, nor any hands-on confirmation that self-hosting works in practice beyond the marketing claim. Missing for 10: concrete self-hosting/deployment docs (Docker/K8s/VM setup guides), independent verification of a self-hosted instance running successfully.
